notes: Tests deepmanual thermistor annual check. Corrected after the Wave 1 agent source review: questions and rubrics distinguish procedure scope, supported alternatives and missing deployment inputs. Claims: t-min-two-points-01, t-points-2c-apart-01, t-points-10c-large-range-01, t-example-4-12-01, t-cal-verif-12mo-01, t-321-verify-12mo-01, t-method1-lab-01, t-method2-insitu-01, t-onepoint-pre-trip-01. These fixture-wide anchors are provisional retrieval labels unless a turn supplies explicit evidence; they are not human sign-off. The current direct-feed slice contains four probe datasheets, so its coverage does not establish the manual-specific requirements.

turns.content: It's time for the yearly check on our temperature sensor. That site runs about 4 to 12 °C over the year — how many check points do we need, and at what temperatures?

must_contain: States a minimum of two verification points
States the points must be within ±2 °C of the annual minimum and maximum
States the points must be within ±4 °C of the annual mean
Gives a point set satisfying the range and spacing rules, with 6 C and 10 C as one valid example for an assumed 8 C annual mean.
Notes this range-verification procedure requires at most five points, without generalizing to every certification procedure
must_not: Requires a fixed number of points the manual does not give
Says a single-point check is enough for annual verification
Recommends points violating the extrema/mean rules or the small-range spacing of at least 2 C and no more than 4 C.

turns.content: Do we have to do that in a lab water bath, or does checking against our reference thermometer in the stream on each visit count?

must_contain: States both a laboratory water-bath comparison and an in situ comparison are acceptable, with neither preferred
States the in situ route meets the annual requirement by verifying against a certified or traceable sensor during each site visit over the year
States verification is required at least once every 12 months
States a one-point check against a certified sensor is also required immediately before a field trip
must_not: Claims the laboratory water bath is the only acceptable method
Invents a mandatory verification interval or permits annual verification less frequently than every 12 months; does not reject legitimate additional checks.
